content.short: A decentralized exchange enhanced with professional trading options on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description: BynetDEX is a decentralized exchange on Cardano that uses Order Book Pattern. It includes professional trading options, such as limit, stop loss, stop market and many other types of orders. With a team of experienced developers and crypto traders we are going to deliver functionality that the community expects. Participants of the DEX are going to be given a choice to become a Trader, Liquidity Provider or a Match-maker. Having various economic incentives one can decide which role fits their strategy best.
content.meta: Find out about BynetDEX (DEX) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
